name: Extract text from a PDF
description: Read a PDF from disk, extract its text page by page, and emit one record per page ready for search or summarisation.
creator: Nodyra maintainers
prerequisites: A PDF readable by the Nodyra process
expected_result: One record per page with its text content.
permissions: Filesystem: the PDF path you configure

params.code:
text = (input or {}).get('text', '') if isinstance(input, dict) else str(input or '')
pages = [p for p in text.split('\f') if p.strip()]
output = [{'page': i + 1, 'text': p.strip()}
          for i, p in enumerate(pages)]
